card.headline: *al ansar* and nejmeh go again on friday.
card.deck: Al Ansar have won both games in Group A. Nejmeh beat Istiklol, then lost 2-1 to Homs Al Fidaa in Group B.

items.note: Al Ansar: 6 points, top of the group

caption:
Two Lebanese clubs, one more group game each in the AFC Challenge League on Friday. ⚽

Al Ansar have won both of their Group A games in Bhutan: 2-0 against Al Ittihad Ahli of Aleppo and 2-1 against Paro, with El Hadji Malick Tall scoring twice. They face Ahal FK at 15:00.

Nejmeh opened Group B in Tajikistan with a 1-0 win over Istiklol, then lost 2-1 to Homs Al Fidaa. They play Al Arabi at 14:00.

Both kick-offs are Beirut time. Who's your pick to score on Friday? 🇱🇧

Source: AFC

facts.claim: Group A (Changlimithang Stadium, Thimphu, Bhutan): Al Ansar 2-0 Al Ittihad Ahli of Aleppo (Sat 17 Oct; Khalil Bader, Nader Matar) and Paro 1-2 Al Ansar (Tue 20 Oct; El Hadji Malick Tall 2 goals); Al Ansar 6 points, top of Group A
Group B (Hisor Central Stadium, Hisor, Tajikistan): Nejmeh 1-0 FC Istiklol (Sat 17 Oct) and Homs Al Fidaa 2-1 Nejmeh (Tue 20 Oct); Nejmeh 3 points, 2nd in Group B (ahead of Istiklol on head-to-head)
Matchday 3, Friday 23 October 2026: Al Arabi v Nejmeh at 14:00 Beirut (16:00 local, Hisor) and Ahal FK v Al Ansar at 15:00 Beirut (18:00 local, Thimphu)
